purpose: Package the previously tested preserved-body ablation as one shared-prefix network. No new training or new quality claim. Verify both held-out checkpoints and fixed 256x256 CPU ONNX inference before any browser use.

protocol.input: float32 sRGB in [0,1], NCHW, existing full-source continuous pixel-edge letterbox with gray 127 padding and prefiltered bilinear shrink
protocol.output: float32 body and exchangeable paper-B probabilities, NCHW; no geometry or valid-template claim
protocol.exporter: torch.onnx.export dynamo=False (installed Torch 2.8 legacy exporter); fixed shape avoids dynamic shape assumptions
protocol.thresholdChanges: Report every changed pixel per head; exact mask parity is a separate gate from probability tolerance.
protocol.timingScope: Warm inference only, two held-out checkpoints on this CPU; excludes downloads, decode, preprocessing and session startup.

limitations: All sixteen photos are repeatedly inspected development cases; original complete-source/motif-held-out fold assignment is retained.
These remain two fold-specific models, not one deployable all-training checkpoint.
The combined graph preserves the original body branch and adapted material branch; it cannot fix their known crop or material failures by packaging alone.
No browser integration, publication, deployment or release approval is implied.
